from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single document from the collection: its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    referenced_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers found in this document's reference list; must be among the provided collection")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated results from all documents in the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
